import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';

import { dbAdmin } from './db';
import { readTenantAuthority, type TenantAuthority } from './tenant-authority';

export async function recordClaimInboundObjectVerification(
  authority: TenantAuthority,
  observed: { decisionId: string; bucket: string; path: string; fileSize: number; sha256: string }
): Promise<boolean> {
  const { tenantId, accessTenantId, principal, purpose } = readTenantAuthority(authority);
  if (purpose !== 'session' || tenantId !== accessTenantId || principal?.role !== 'staff') {
    return false;
  }

  return dbAdmin.transaction(async tx => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local role interdomestik_wp12_verifier`);
    await tx.execute(sql`set local row_security = on`);
    await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('app.current_tenant_id', ${tenantId}, true)`);
    await tx.execute(
      sql`select set_config('app.current_access_tenant_id', ${accessTenantId}, true)`
    );
    await tx.execute(sql`
      select set_config('app.current_actor_id', ${principal.userId}, true),
             set_config('app.current_actor_role', ${principal.role}, true),
             set_config('app.current_actor_branch_id', ${principal.branchId ?? ''}, true)
    `);
    const rows = await tx.execute<{ recorded: boolean }>(sql`
      select public.record_claim_inbound_object_verification(
        ${observed.decisionId}::uuid, ${observed.bucket}::text, ${observed.path}::text,
        ${observed.fileSize}::integer, ${observed.sha256}::text
      ) as recorded
    `);
    if (rows.length !== 1 || typeof rows[0]?.recorded !== 'boolean') {
      throw new Error('Unexpected inbound verification result');
    }
    return rows[0].recorded;
  });
}
